title: The canned job warning stays until closed, is the only toast, and the line holds only the other parts
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. Canned job "QAPL Canned" holds QAPL-T1 (active, tracked) and QAPL-I1 (inactive here), plus a fee on QAPL-I1 (note the fee's name; it is {fee} below). An open work order at Staging Heavy Duty. No other toast on screen before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order and click New Line.
  2. In "What are you doing?" pick the canned job "QAPL Canned", then click Save & Close.
  3. Look at every toast on screen while the warning shows (top of the page and the usual toast area).
  4. Leave the warning untouched for at least 20 seconds.
  5. Click the warning's close X.
  6. Expand the new line and look at its parts and fees.
  7. Open the work order's Parts tab.
custom_expected:
1. The new line form opens with "What are you doing?".
  2. The new line is created. One orange warning toast (toast_canned_line_warning) shows: "These parts are inactive and were not added: QAPL-I1." and "The {fee} fee for QAPL-I1 was not added."
  3. The canned job warning is the only toast: no success, info or error toast appears with it.
  4. The warning is still on screen; it does not fade on its own (it stays until closed).
  5. The warning closes.
  6. The line holds QAPL-T1 only: no QAPL-I1 part and no {fee} fee for QAPL-I1.
  7. QAPL-T1 is listed for the new line; QAPL-I1 is not.
